description: Multi-turn chat with the Delco Plumber Now assistant in plain language: ask questions, get a typical price range, and get the person connected with a local plumber. Pass the conversation_id from the previous reply to continue. When the person agrees to be contacted and shares a phone or email, the reply includes ready_to_submit with their details; submitting is done separately with request_contact. Use this for open-ended questions; use the single-purpose tools when you only need coverage, a price range or the phone number. Returns JSON with the reply, the conversation_id and call/text links; up to 30 messages per conversation.

conversation_id.description: From the previous reply (c_ plus 16 hex characters); omit to start a new conversation

message.description: What the person (or you, on their behalf) wants to say or ask, in plain words, up to 2000 characters

name: chat_with_delco_plumber_now
